description:
Practical preparedness for the second half of life. Walt's Prepper Playbook covers emergency preparedness, blackout survival, and home readiness for folks in their 50s, 60s, and beyond — no bunkers, no fantasy, no panic.

Most survival advice is written for 25-year-olds with strong knees and two thousand dollars to burn. This channel isn't. Here you'll find realistic, shelter-in-place preparedness built around the home you already live in: power outages, winter storms, water shutoffs, and supply disruptions. Light systems that don't demand a strong back. Smart stockpiles that don't demand a second mortgage. And the forgotten skills our parents and grandparents relied on before the grid did everything for us — because most of what preppers are rediscovering today, they already knew.

Every video is one clear plan: what to do, why it works, and how to set it up this week.

Experience isn't a weakness in a crisis. It's the best gear you own.

New videos every week.
